notes:
Summary: procurement-stage enterprise account. Primary use-case is high-volume contract ingestion + clause extraction and a legal-facing chat assistant. They require private deployment or on-prem due to client confidentiality and regulatory obligations. Legal pushed back hard on DPA/MTA — key redline items: explicit data residency guarantees, no caching of PII outside customer VPC, contractual KMS/HSM key control language, and stricter breach notification windows.

Call excerpts / paraphrase: 
- Head of Legal: "We can't accept vendor-managed KV cache unless keys are customer-controlled."
- CTO (Rajiv): "If you can commit to on-prem bundle + SOC2 artifacts we can move forward, finance needs numbers."

What we submitted: draft MSA + DPA (redline sent 2024-12-20). Legal counter received 2024-12-29 with two hot points: residency clause (EU/US separation) and escrow for model artifacts. Procurement then put vendor onboarding on hold over year-end; primary procurement lead informed AE via Slack 2024-12-22 that vendor intake paused until new insurance certificate arrives.

Competitive situation: procurement initiated a short pilot with Evisort (3-week POC) during our procurement freeze; we learned this via procurement contact 2025-01-08. Evisort's standard MSA accepted by their legal team faster due to fewer residency guarantees requested.

Internal notes (sales): SE Priya did a detailed architecture session showing VPC + private control plane on 2024-11-20 and demoed audit log flow and key rotation. Security asked for SOC2 Type II evidence and data-flow diagrams (submitted 2024-12-10). Still outstanding: signed attestation, encryption key control language, and an explicit clause around caching/kv retention.

Risk: account likely to slip if we don't get legal exec-level engagement. Procurement is risk-averse and on a temporary freeze for new vendors. Finance wants line-item proof of cost per 10k contracts vs competitor pilot.

Tone: terse, fragmented notes preferred by AE. Reps are frustrated: "we're functionally ready, blocked by redlines + vendor intake".

Suggested approach: escalate DPA redlines to legal operations, propose a narrow temporary carve-out for POC (no external KV caching, strict retention), offer an in-contract timeline for SOC2 doc delivery, and request a joint call with CFO + Head of Legal to resolve residency clause.
